flawless: I remember Argoth before the sky fell. You are no great storm.
Two lands awake and two more waking. You could not keep pace.
solid: You wounded an old elf. The young ones will be scandalised.
Argoth's memory runs deep. Yours will fade, but this lesson won't.
close: I lived through the end of a continent, and you came close to ending me.
Even Titania's forest would have trembled at that. Well fought.
